exposure: Induction of labor for severe SGA
Planned caesarean section for severe SGA
cohort: The study included 434 foetuses with severe small for gestational age (< 3rd centile) in cephalic presentation, needing foetal extraction, born to mothers with a single foetus.
finding: Induction of labor for severe SGA before 37 weeks' gestation doubled the risk of moderate or severe neonatal acidosis (7.9%) compared to planned caesarean section (3.1%).
mod_finding: Induction of labor for severe SGA before 37 weeks' gestation resulted in vaginal delivery for two-thirds (66.4%) of the cases.
birth_weight: Severe Small for Gestational Age (< 3rd centile) estimated according to the birth weight ratio
